name: skills
description: Authored Claude Code agent skills. design-patterns runs a short dialog to settle the shape of code before it is written — naming the axis of change, starting from the direct version, and leaving the choice open. explain-it-to-me turns a body of git work into a briefing that reads the diff rather than rewording the log. markdown is a design spec for .md files that survive the renderer they end up in. run-script-handoff covers the conventions for handing a human a command to run in their own terminal and paste back.
